scenario: A theme-park dashboard stores ride wait times only if they exceed 45 minutes. The operator wants the mean wait across all operating intervals.

data.description: Only waits above 45 minutes are observed. Wait time is Normal with known sigma 15 minutes.

question: Estimate (a) the true mean wait mu across all intervals and (b) the fraction of intervals represented in the dashboard.
naive_answer: Average wait is about 52.1 minutes because that is the dashboard mean.
reasoning_trace: Alpha≈1.3 gives mu=45-1.3*15=25.5 and observed fraction about 0.0968.
python_verification:
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(45-mu)/15; return mu+15*norm.pdf(a)/norm.sf(a)-52.05
mu=brentq(eq,-100,44.99)
frac=norm.sf((45-mu)/15)
assert abs(mu-25.5)<1 and abs(frac-0.0968)<0.005
